title: Production of bovine beta-lactoglobulin and hen egg ovalbumin by Trichoderma reesei using precision fermentation technology and testing of their techno-functional properties
one_line_finding: The anchor paper for this batch: BLG 1 g/L (0.8 g/L on lactose/spent grain) and OVA 2 g/L in 1 L fed-batch T. reesei using a synthetic (SES) promoter and a CBHI carrier.

title: Efficient Production of the Recombinant Human Lactoferrin in an Engineered Trichoderma reesei
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
one_line_finding: First rhLF production in T. reesei: 184.76 to 368.47 mg/L in flasks (pdi1 overexpression + pea1 deletion + bran/Tween-80), 1349.5 mg/L in a 5 L fermenter.

title: Secretory expression of porcine lactoferrin in Trichoderma reesei and characterization of the recombinant protein
one_line_finding: Porcine lactoferrin at 2.37 g/L in a 30-L fermenter from a Pcbh1-driven cbh1-replacement strain with pea1 and cbh2 deleted - the highest food-protein titer found in any filamentous host.

title: Two-Step Engineering of Food-Grade Aspergillus oryzae via Endogenous Signal Peptides and Vesicle Trafficking Proteins to Enhance Carrier-Free Secretion
one_line_finding: Bovine kappa-casein secreted carrier-free from A. oryzae at 0.11 to 0.24 mg/L, rising to 4.14 mg/L on 10 g/L yeast extract - three orders of magnitude below T. reesei whey/egg protein titers.

title: Label-free analytical characterization of brazzein produced with the filamentous fungus Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: Sweet protein brazzein at ~1.3 g/L in T. reesei bioreactors on the same VTT SES platform; also states a single heterologous protein has reached >80 g/L at VTT (unpublished).

title: Exploration of the Strategy for Improving the Expression of Heterologous Sweet Protein Monellin in Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: Monellin only 0.284 mg/L in A. niger shake flasks despite 25-30 g/L homologous glucoamylase - the clearest statement of the homologous/heterologous gap in this host.

title: Enabling low cost biopharmaceuticals: high level interferon alpha-2b production in Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: Landowski/VTT protease-deletion series: IFN alpha-2b to 2.4 g/L (damp2) and 4.5 g/L free / 6.3 g/L total with soybean trypsin inhibitor - the non-food single-protein ceiling in T. reesei.

title: Enabling Low Cost Biopharmaceuticals: A Systematic Approach to Delete Proteases from a Well-Known Protein Production Host Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: The 9-protease-deletion lineage behind the IFN work; also records 23 g/L total secreted protein in flasks and the classic CBHI-carrier benchmarks (chymosin and murine Fab both 150 mg/L).

title: Novel genetic tools that enable highly pure protein production in Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: The synthetic expression system (SES) used for BLG/OVA/brazzein: ~98% reduction of the native secretome while reaching ~10 g/L total protein that is mostly CBHI-carrier plus CalB.

title: Rational engineering of the Trichoderma reesei RUT-C30 strain into an industrially relevant platform for cellulase production
one_line_finding: 80.6 g/L extracellular protein (0.24 g/L/h) on sugarcane molasses - described by the authors as the highest experimentally supported titer reported for T. reesei.

title: Functional engineering of the ACE3 C-terminal residue S705 improves cellulase production in Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: ACE3 S705H point mutation gives ~125 g/L extracellular protein in a 30-L fermenter - the highest filamentous-fungal secreted-protein number encountered, abstract only.

title: Inducer-free recombinant protein production in Trichoderma reesei: secretory production of endogenous enzymes and heterologous nanobodies using glucose as the sole carbon source
one_line_finding: Glucose-only, inducer-free cbh1/cbh2 double-replacement strains secrete caplacizumab at 508 mg/L (296 mg/L without protease inhibitors) and >400 mg/L for 1ZVH and ozoralizumab.

title: Comparison of intracellular and secretion-based strategies for production of human alpha-galactosidase A in the filamentous fungus Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: Human alpha-galactosidase A: 20 mg/L secreted via CBHI carrier versus 636 mg/L retained intracellularly with a ZERA tag - a 32x penalty for the secretion route on this product.

title: Achieving efficient protein expression in Trichoderma reesei by using strong constitutive promoters
one_line_finding: Constitutive pdc and eno promoters give xylanase II at 1.61 and 1.52 g/L, 82-83% of total secreted protein, without cellulase induction.

title: Expression of Melanocarpus albomyces laccase in Trichoderma reesei and characterization of the purified enzyme
one_line_finding: Non-fused laccase ~230 mg/L in shake flasks and 920 mg/L in fed-batch; the hydrophobin fusion accumulated intracellularly and was degraded.

title: Characterization of Melanocarpus albomyces steryl esterase produced in Trichoderma reesei and modification of fibre products with the enzyme
one_line_finding: Steryl esterase STE1 at an estimated 280 mg/L in a laboratory bioreactor.

title: Homologous Overexpression of Tyrosinase in Trichoderma reesei and Its Application in Glycinin Cross-Linking
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
one_line_finding: Homologous tyrosinase at ~2.16 g/L in Rut-C30 shake flasks; used to cross-link soy glycinin, raising emulsion stability 30.6%.

title: Expression of a SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing nanobody in Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: Nanobody Nb20 at 47.4 mg/L in glucose shake flasks under Pcdna1 with a CBHI N-terminal fusion cleaved by KEX2.

title: Production of a chimeric enzyme tool associating the Trichoderma reesei swollenin with the Aspergillus niger feruloyl esterase A
one_line_finding: Swollenin-FaeA chimera produced up to 25 mg/L in T. reesei.

title: Efficient Extracellular Production of Insulin Glargine in Trichoderma reesei by an Integrative Secretion-Based Strategy
one_line_finding: Insulin glargine secreted via a CBH1 carrier, 58.95 mIU/L in flasks and 144.75 mIU/L in a 1 L bioreactor - reported only in activity units, so NO mg/L row could be made without an unsafe conversion.

title: A multi-plex protein expression system for production of complex enzyme formulations in Trichoderma reesei
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: 2A-peptide multi-gene cassettes give a fixed ~18:2:1 CBH1:second:BGL1 expression ratio (128, 13 and 5 pmol); reported in pmol, not mg/L, so no titer row.

title: Enhancing the production of a heterologous Trametes laccase (LacA) by replacement of the major cellulase CBH1 in Trichoderma reesei
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: cbh1 replacement raises Trametes LacA to 168.3 U/L on 4% lactose; activity only, no mg/L. Useful for the statement that 230 mg/L remains the best laccase level in T. reesei.

title: Modification of transcriptional factor ACE3 enhances protein production in Trichoderma reesei in the absence of cellulase gene inducer
one_line_finding: Truncated ACE3 gives inducer-independent secretion with ~10-20% improved yields; no absolute mg/L titer for a heterologous product.

title: Reduced viscosity mutants of Trichoderma reesei with improved industrial fermentation characteristics
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: sfb3/ssb7/seb1/mpg1 morphology mutations cut broth viscosity and double volumetric productivity of secreted protein; relative only, no absolute titers.

title: Evolution and screening of Trichoderma reesei mutants for secreted protein production at elevated temperature
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: A gef1 deletion lets a high-productivity whole-cellulase strain secrete at 28 C instead of 25 C; process-cost relevant, no absolute titer.

title: Enhanced heterologous gene expression in Trichoderma reesei by promoting multicopy integration
one_line_finding: Multicopy integration strategy for raising heterologous expression; no mg/L titer extractable from the accessible text.

title: A universal gene expression system for fungi
one_line_finding: The Rantasalo synthetic expression system (SES) itself - the promoter platform that all the VTT food-protein titers rest on.

title: Transcriptomics analysis identifies folding and secretion related genes for improving monoclonal antibody production in Thermothelomyces heterothallica
one_line_finding: C1 secretes >120 g/L native enzymes and mAbs at >20 g/L (mAb1 >24 g/L, nivolumab/mAb2 20-22 g/L, 13 g/L with human-like glycans) - several of these are 'data not shown'.

title: The landscape of antibody production systems: recombinant expression for research, diagnostics and therapy
one_line_finding: Table 4 is the single best compilation of antibody titers in filamentous fungi: T. reesei, A. awamori/luchuensis, A. oryzae, N. crassa and T. heterothallica (HuMab 87G7 at 1.6 g/L, the best full antibody).

title: Thermophilic Filamentous Fungus C1-Cell-Cloned SARS-CoV-2-Spike-RBD-Subunit-Vaccine Adjuvanted with Aldydrogel
one_line_finding: C1-RBD-C-tag at ~1 g/L crude, 800 mg/L purified at >97% after 4-day fermentation, with a claim of >2 g/L after further optimization.

title: Semi-automated strain engineering and screening in the thermophilic fungus Myceliophthora thermophila for recombinant protein production
one_line_finding: Iterative automated screening reached ~1.1 g/L extracellular protein in flasks and 5.9 g/L in a 5-L fermentation on glucose over 144 h.

title: Development of an efficient protein expression system in the thermophilic fungus Myceliophthora thermophila
one_line_finding: Expression-system development for M. thermophila; no mg/L titer recoverable from the accessible full text.

title: Commercial Levels of Chymosin Production by Aspergillus
one_line_finding: The classic benchmark: mutagenesis plus robotic screening gave >1 g/L secreted authentic bovine chymosin in A. niger var. awamori, with improved general secretion capacity.

title: Aspergillus: A Powerful Protein Production Platform
one_line_finding: Review supplying the A. awamori chymosin protease-deletion numbers (~430 vs ~180 mg/L), A. oryzae human lysozyme (25.4/26.5/35.8 mg/L), A. niger HEWL (8-10, up to 30-60 mg/L) and MnP (14 to 60-73 mg/L).

title: Heterologous protein production in filamentous fungi
one_line_finding: Broad review: A. niger hEPO 73.9 mg/L, A. niger G-CSF-GlaA 5-10 mg/L, T. reesei IFN alpha-2b 2.1-4.5 g/L, and the general 1-2000 mg/L range for fungal heterologous products.

title: Genetic Engineering of Filamentous Fungi for Efficient Protein Expression and Secretion
one_line_finding: Secretion-engineering review; source for the G-CSF glucoamylase-fusion figure of 5-10 mg/L in A. niger.

title: Development of an efficient heterologous protein expression platform in Aspergillus niger through genetic modification of a glucoamylase hyperproducer
one_line_finding: Glucoamylase-hyperproducer chassis gives 110.8-416.8 mg/L in flasks across three targets: glucose oxidase 364 mg/L, LZ8 up to 130.5 mg/L, MtPlyA up to 423.7 mg/L.

title: Expression and characterization of recombinant IL-1Ra in Aspergillus oryzae as a system
one_line_finding: Human IL-1Ra purified at 53 mg/L from A. oryzae; N-glycosylated and longer-lived in vitro than the E. coli product (anakinra).

title: Large-Scale Production of Anti-RNase A VHH Expressed in pyrG Auxotrophic Aspergillus oryzae
one_line_finding: Anti-RNase A VHH at 44 mg/L in shake flasks and 1.4 g/L in a fermenter - the best antibody-fragment titer found for any Aspergillus host.

title: High-Level Production of Aspartic Proteinase in Aspergillus niger via Combinatorial Engineering Strategies
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
one_line_finding: Engineered A. niger reaches 31,104 U/mL proteinase with 27.5 g/L extracellular protein in a 5 L fermenter.

title: Cultivation of recombinant Aspergillus niger strains on dairy whey as a carbohydrate source
journal: Journal of Industrial Microbiology and Biotechnology
one_line_finding: Shows recombinant A. niger growing on bovine and soy whey; supplies the 30 g/L GlaA glucoamylase benchmark for the host. No heterologous mg/L titer.

title: Overexpression of msnA reprograms metabolism to enhance recombinant protein secretion across Aspergillus species
one_line_finding: msnA overexpression improves secretion across Aspergillus spp.; source of the host-class range statement (filamentous fungi 5-100 g/L vs bacteria 0.5-3, yeasts 1-22).

title: Combining manipulation of integration loci and secretory pathway on expression of an Aspergillus niger glucose oxidase
one_line_finding: States that heterologous yields in T. reesei do not exceed 1 g/L (20-700 mg/L typical) against >100 g/L endogenous cellulase - a useful, if now outdated, ceiling claim.

title: Heterologous expression of Thermomyces lanuginosus lipase in Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: Lipase benchmark attempt - the paper reports activity (U/mL) and fermentation optimization only, no mg/L, so the lipase titer benchmark for A. niger remains a gap.

title: Atmospheric room-temperature plasma mutagenesis and heterologous expression of dextranase in Aspergillus niger
one_line_finding: Dextranase expression in A. niger; reported as activity only, no mg/L titer.

title: High-level production of Aspergillus niger prolyl endopeptidase from agricultural residue and its application in beer
one_line_finding: AN-PEP produced from agricultural residue; the paper gives application doses (~2.5 mg/L in beer) rather than a fermentation titer.

title: Scientific and technological challenges of recombinant egg protein production
one_line_finding: Table 2 compiles all reported recombinant egg-protein titers; the only fungal entry is T. reesei ovalbumin at 2 g/L (Aro et al.). States ~50 g/L is needed for commodity economics.

title: Toward Rational Design of Precision-Fermented Milk Proteins
journal: Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety
one_line_finding: Review of precision-fermented milk proteins; PMC page was behind a CAPTCHA on fetch, so no quotes were taken from it.

title: Protein secretion and associated stress in industrially employed filamentous fungi
one_line_finding: Secretion-stress review for industrial filamentous fungi; context for the UPR/protease engineering that drives most of the titer gains above.

title: An overview on current molecular tools for heterologous gene expression in Trichoderma
one_line_finding: Tool review; repeats the ~100 g/L secretion-capacity figure for T. reesei.

title: Non-Mammalian Eukaryotic Expression Systems Yeast and Fungi in the Production of Biologics
one_line_finding: Comparative host review for biologics; background on where filamentous fungi sit against yeasts and CHO.

title: Ovalbumin production using Trichoderma reesei culture and low-carbon energy could mitigate the environmental impacts of chicken-egg-derived ovalbumin
one_line_finding: Life-cycle assessment of T. reesei ovalbumin (Jarvio et al.); environmental case, no fermentation titer of its own.

title: Multi-omics profiling finds synbio milk differs nutritionally from bovine milk and contains 93 uncharacterized fungal proteins
one_line_finding: Characterizes a commercial precision-fermentation milk-protein product and its residual fungal proteins - relevant to downstream purity, not to titer.

title: Mycotoxin-free Aspergillus oryzae strain lineage for alternative and novel protein production at industrial scale
one_line_finding: A mycotoxin-free A. oryzae lineage intended as a food-protein chassis; no heterologous titer reported.

title: Production of Recombinant Hemoglobin in Tremella fuciformis Yeast-like Cells Through Selection of Hemoglobins and Secretion Elements
one_line_finding: Closest globin result found in a fungus (not a filamentous ascomycete host): Cyanobacterial Hb 106.43 mg/L extracellular in Tremella fuciformis. No globin titers exist for T. reesei or Aspergillus.

title: Secretory Production of Plant Heme-Containing Globins by Recombinant Yeast via Precision Fermentation
one_line_finding: Soy leghemoglobin at 398.1 mg/L in S. cerevisiae and 1652.7 mg/L in K. phaffii - the yeast comparator for the globin gap in filamentous hosts.

title: Safety evaluation of the food enzyme chymosin from the genetically modified Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: Confirms chymosin is commercially produced in GM T. reesei today; EFSA dossiers report activity and purity, not titers.

title: Fungal expression strategies for heterologous production of antimicrobial peptides
one_line_finding: Review of carrier/fusion strategies for small peptides in fungal hosts - relevant to why small food proteins such as caseins secrete poorly.

title: Characterization of Recombinant Antimicrobial Peptide BMGlv2 Heterologously Expressed in Trichoderma reesei
one_line_finding: BMGlv2 peptide expressed in T. reesei; no mg/L titer given in the full text, only characterization.
